svg.aria-label: Strip plot of expected calibration error across 49 benchmark suites for two Laya checkpoints. As shipped the means are 0.466 and 0.314; after refitting the temperature on held-out data they fall to 0.081 and 0.106.
svg.title: Strip plot of expected calibration error across 49 benchmark suites for two Laya checkpoints. As shipped the means are 0.466 and 0.314; after refitting the temperature on held-out data they fall to 0.081 and 0.106.
svg.text: Refitting the temperature is the cheapest fix available
Calibration error (ECE) on 49 benchmark suites, as shipped and after refitting T on held-out data. Lower is better.
Data: NandhaKishorM/laya, research/results/t4_colab_benchmark.json (calibration_repair). Each dot is one suite; tick = mean.
